mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item ( round_id, name, qty, price ) SELECT r.id, #{name}, COALESCE(#{qty}, 1), #{price} FROM settle_round r WHERE r.id = #{roundId} AND r.settlement_id = #{settlementId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.round_id, r.settlement_id, i.name, i.qty, i.price FROM item i JOIN settle_round r ON r.id = i.round_id WHERE r.settlement_id = #{settlementId} ORDER BY i.round_id ASC, i.id ASC
